versions.content: {DRAFT} Reception of an IEEE1722TpConnection If the IEEE1722TpConnection references a PduTriggering in role pdu and that PduTriggering refers to an IPduPort (in the context of an EcuInstance ) in the role iPduPort with communicationDirection set to CommunicationDirec- tionType . in , then the IEEE1722TpConnection is received by that EcuInstance .
